text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 37.5°C (99.5°F), Blood Pressure 127/68 mmHg, Heart Rate 125 bpm, Respiratory Rate 18 breaths/min, Oxygen Saturation 98% on room air. speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms severe drug-induced epidermal necrosis, consistent with Stevens-Johnson Syndrome. Which specific medications were you recently prescribed for your arthritis and cough before the rash appeared? DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
